title: POWERICA — Equity Report · 24 May 2026
catalyst: Data-centre demand super-cycle for DG sets (24-36 months): India's data-centre installed capacity is set to grow from ~1.4 GW today to 9 GW by 2030. Powerica's data-centre order book is already ~12-13% of revenue and management expects it to reach 15%+ within 12 months.

title: POWERICA — Equity Report · 20 May 2026
